name: Temporal Barrier
body:
School abjuration; Level: jester 7

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of your next turn, any creature that enters a space adjacent to you without using a 5-foot step immediately ends its turn and is stunned until the end of your next turn.
